translationRepairs: On guichou day in the third month he halted at Lushui. His younger brother Yeci Getu, whom he had made King of Xi, came with Anduan at the head of more than a thousand horsemen, pretending that they had come to attend court.

On guichou day in the third month he halted at Lushui. His younger brother Diela plotted to become King of Xi and, together with Anduan at the head of more than a thousand horsemen, arrived, falsely claiming they had come to attend court.
圖為奚王 describes Diela's design to become King of Xi. The proposal fixes the syntax, but the historically standard name is Diela, not Dielage.

On guichou day in the third month, halting at Lushui, the younger brother Yeci Getu, who had been made King of Xi, arrived with Anduan leading more than a thousand horsemen, falsely claiming they came to pay court.

On guichou day in the third month, halting at Lushui, his younger brother Diela plotted to become King of Xi and arrived with Anduan leading more than a thousand horsemen, falsely claiming they had come to pay court.
The literal field also invents 'Yeci Getu' and misparses 圖為. Diela is the standard name of Abaoji's younger brother 迭剌.
On the jiaxu new moon of the second month, You Zhen, Prince of Jun of Liang, attacked and killed his elder brother You, and succeeded to the throne.
On the jiaxu new moon of the second month, Youzhen, Prince of Jun of Liang, attacked and killed his elder brother You, and succeeded to the throne.
友貞 is the single given name Youzhen; splitting it as You Zhen is incorrect.
In the tenth winter month, on wuyin day, Cige took Pingzhou and came back, only to rise again with Yeci, Yindishi, Anduan, and the rest.
In the tenth winter month, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.
迭剌 is the emperor's younger brother Yelü Diela. Both 'Yeci' and the proposal's 'Dieci' are nonstandard misreadings.
Pursued to Chai River, they thereupon burned their carts, mounts, and tents and fled.
Pursued to Chai River, they thereupon burned their carts, wagons, and tents and fled.
車乘 means carts or carriages; 'mounts' is unsupported and duplicates the vehicle sense poorly.
His partisans Kuguzhi and Moduo all came with faces bound to beg forgiveness.
His partisans Kuguzhi and Moduo all came forward with their hands bound to beg forgiveness.
面縛 is the submission posture of binding one's hands behind one's back, not binding one's face.
Because Yindishi and Anduan were by nature weak and foolish and had been used by Cige, their crimes were all pardoned.
Because Yindishi and Anduan were by nature mediocre and weak and had been used by Cige, their crimes were all pardoned.
庸弱 means mediocre and weak; it does not add the separate judgment 'foolish.'
On wuwu day Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dieci department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.
On wuwu day Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dielie department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.
The department is 迭烈, Dielie. 'Dieci' misreads the final character 烈.
On wuwu day, Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dieci Department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.
On wuwu day, Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dielie Department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.
The literal field must likewise render 迭烈部 as the Dielie Department.
